ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
500 g chicken pieces
1 cup yogurt
2 sliced onions
1 tbsp garam masala
3 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for about 20 minutes and marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, and salt.
Cook the rice until it is about 70 percent done and set it aside.
In a large pot sauté onions in oil until golden and cook the marinated chicken until tender.
Layer the partially cooked rice over the chicken, cover tightly and cook on low heat for dum cooking.

ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
500 g mutton pieces
1 cup yogurt
2 chopped onions
Mixed biryani spices
3 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice and marinate mutton with yogurt and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Pressure cook the mutton with spices until it becomes tender and flavorful.
Cook rice separately until partially done and prepare a spiced onion base.
Layer mutton and rice together and cook on low heat so the flavors combine well.

ingredients:
2 cups idli rice
1 cup urad dal
1 tsp salt
Water as required
instructions:
Soak rice and urad dal separately for at least 4 hours.
Grind them into a smooth batter and mix with salt before allowing it to ferment overnight.
Grease idli molds and pour the fermented batter into the molds.
Steam the idlis for about 10 minutes until soft and fluffy.

ingredients:
2 cups dosa rice
1 cup urad dal
2 tbsp oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Soak rice and urad dal for several hours and grind them into a smooth batter.
Allow the batter to ferment overnight so it becomes airy and flavorful.
Heat a dosa tawa and spread a ladle of batter thinly across the surface.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook until the dosa turns golden and crisp.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup yogurt
2 tsp red chili powder
Curry leaves
Oil for frying
Salt to taste
instructions:
Marinate chicken with yogurt, chili powder, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the marinated chicken pieces until crispy.
In another pan sauté curry leaves and spices for tempering.
Add the fried chicken to the tempering and toss well before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup rice
1/2 cup toor dal
Mixed vegetables like carrot and beans
1 tbsp tamarind paste
2 tbsp sambar powder
instructions:
Cook rice and toor dal separately until soft.
Prepare sambar by boiling vegetables with tamarind paste and sambar powder.
Add cooked dal to the sambar mixture and simmer for a few minutes.
Mix the cooked rice with the prepared sambar and serve hot.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 fresh lemon juice
2 tbsp roasted peanuts
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they start to splutter.
Add peanuts and sauté them lightly until golden.
Mix the cooked rice with lemon juice and salt in a bowl.
Combine the tempering with the rice and mix gently before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
2 chopped tomatoes
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté tomatoes with spices until soft and pulpy.
Cook the mixture until the oil separates and forms a thick masala.
Add cooked rice to the tomato masala and mix gently.
Cook for a few minutes so the flavors combine before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables
1/2 cup coconut paste
1 tsp garam masala
1 onion chopped
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until translucent.
Add mixed vegetables and cook them for a few minutes.
Mix coconut paste and spices into the vegetables to create a thick gravy.
Simmer the curry until vegetables are tender and flavors blend well.

ingredients:
250 g paneer cubes
2 tomatoes pureed
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Heat butter in a pan and sauté tomato puree with spices.
Cook the gravy until it becomes thick and aromatic.
Add paneer cubes and simmer gently in the gravy.
Finish with cream and cook briefly before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups chickpeas soaked overnight
2 cups all purpose flour
1/2 cup yogurt
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 onion finely chopped
1 tbsp chole masala
Salt to taste
instructions:
Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook them until soft and tender.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions with spices until fragrant, then add the cooked chickpeas and simmer to form a thick curry.
Prepare dough using flour, yogurt, salt and water, and allow it to rest for 30 minutes.
Roll small discs from the dough and deep fry them in hot oil until puffed and golden, then serve hot with the chole.

ingredients:
1 cup rajma beans soaked overnight
2 cups cooked basmati rice
2 tomatoes finely chopped
1 onion chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Soak rajma beans overnight and pressure cook them until soft.
In a pan heat oil and sauté onions and tomatoes with spices until the mixture forms a thick masala.
Add cooked rajma with some water and simmer the curry so the flavors blend well.
Serve the hot rajma curry over freshly cooked basmati rice.

ingredients:
2 cups fresh spinach leaves
200 g paneer cubes
1/2 cup fresh cream
1 onion chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Blanch spinach leaves in boiling water and blend them into a smooth green puree.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and spices until aromatic.
Add the spinach puree and cook for a few minutes until it thickens.
Add paneer cubes and cream, simmer briefly and serve hot.

ingredients:
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 boiled potatoes mashed
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp chili powder
2 tbsp butter
Salt to taste
instructions:
Prepare a soft dough using whole wheat flour, salt, and water and allow it to rest.
Mix mashed potatoes with spices and herbs to prepare the filling.
Stuff the potato mixture inside small dough balls and roll them into flat parathas.
Cook the parathas on a hot tawa with butter until golden brown on both sides.

ingredients:
2 cups wheat flour
3 boiled potatoes
1 onion sliced
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Prepare a stiff dough with wheat flour, salt, and water and rest it for 15 minutes.
Roll small discs from the dough and deep fry them in hot oil until puffed and golden.
In another pan prepare potato masala by sautéing mustard seeds, onions, and spices.
Add mashed potatoes and cook briefly before serving with hot pooris.

ingredients:
1 cup semolina (rava)
1/2 cup mixed vegetables
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 green chili chopped
Salt to taste
instructions:
Dry roast the semolina in a pan until it becomes aromatic and lightly golden.
Heat oil in another pan and add mustard seeds, green chilies, and vegetables.
Add water and bring it to a boil before slowly adding the roasted semolina.
Stir continuously until the mixture thickens and the upma becomes soft and fluffy.

ingredients:
1 cup rice
1/2 cup moong dal
1 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp ghee
1 tsp cumin seeds
Salt to taste
instructions:
Dry roast moong dal lightly until aromatic.
Cook rice and dal together in water until soft and mushy.
Heat ghee in a pan and sauté cumin seeds and black pepper.
Mix the tempering with the cooked rice and dal mixture and serve hot.

ingredients:
1 cup urad dal
1 tsp black pepper
1 green chili chopped
Oil for deep frying
Salt to taste
instructions:
Soak urad dal for a few hours and grind it into a thick batter.
Add chopped chilies, pepper, and salt to the batter and mix well.
Shape small doughnut shaped vadas using wet hands.
Deep fry them in hot oil until crisp and golden brown.

ingredients:
500 g fish pieces
1 tbsp tamarind paste
2 tomatoes chopped
1 onion sliced
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp chili powder
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and tomatoes with spices until soft.
Add tamarind paste and water to create a tangy curry base.
Place the fish pieces gently into the simmering gravy.
Cook on medium heat until the fish becomes tender and the flavors combine well.

ingredients:
400 g cleaned prawns
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garlic paste
Salt to taste
instructions:
Marinate the prawns with chili powder, turmeric, garlic paste, and salt for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and add the marinated prawns.
Cook the prawns on medium heat until they turn golden and slightly crisp.
Stir occasionally to coat them well with spices and serve hot.

ingredients:
4 boiled eggs
2 tomatoes finely chopped
1 onion chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Boil the eggs until firm, peel the shells, and keep them aside.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions and tomatoes with spices until the mixture becomes thick.
Add water to create a curry base and allow it to simmer for a few minutes.
Place the boiled eggs in the gravy and cook briefly so they absorb the flavors.

ingredients:
1 cup yogurt
3 tbsp gram flour (besan)
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp cumin seeds
Oil for frying pakoras
Salt to taste
instructions:
Prepare pakoras by mixing gram flour, spices, and water into a thick batter and deep frying small portions.
Whisk yogurt with gram flour, turmeric, and water to form a smooth mixture.
Cook the yogurt mixture on low heat while stirring continuously until it thickens.
Add the fried pakoras into the kadhi and simmer gently before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas)
1 onion sliced
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice for about 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and spices until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and cook them lightly for a few minutes.
Add rice and water, cover the pot, and cook until the rice becomes fluffy and fully cooked.

ingredients:
2 cups dosa batter
3 boiled potatoes
1 onion sliced
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
Salt to taste
instructions:
Prepare the potato masala by sautéing mustard seeds, onions, spices, and mashed potatoes.
Heat a dosa tawa and spread a ladle of fermented dosa batter into a thin circle.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook until the dosa turns crisp.
Place the potato masala inside the dosa, fold it, and serve hot.

ingredients:
1 cup grated cabbage
1/2 cup grated carrot
3 tbsp all purpose flour
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garlic paste
instructions:
Mix cabbage, carrot, flour, salt, and spices to form small vegetable balls.
Deep fry the vegetable balls in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
In another pan prepare the Manchurian sauce using soy sauce, garlic, and spices.
Add the fried vegetable balls to the sauce and toss well before serving.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
2 tomatoes pureed
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp garam masala
Salt to taste
instructions:
Marinate chicken with spices and yogurt for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the marinated chicken in a pan until lightly browned.
Prepare a rich tomato gravy using butter, tomato puree, and spices.
Add chicken to the gravy and finish with cream before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup toor dal
3 cloves garlic chopped
2 tbsp ghee
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tomato chopped
Salt to taste
instructions:
Wash and pressure cook the toor dal until soft and mushy.
Mash the dal slightly and add water to achieve the desired consistency.
Heat ghee in a small pan and sauté garlic, cumin seeds, and spices.
Pour this tempering over the cooked dal and mix well before serving.

ingredients:
200 g paneer grated
2 boiled potatoes mashed
1/2 cup cream
2 tomatoes pureed
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Mix paneer, potatoes, and spices to form soft kofta balls.
Deep fry the koftas in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Prepare a rich gravy using tomato puree, cream, and spices.
Add the fried koftas to the gravy just before serving so they remain soft.

ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp ghee
Salt to taste
Water as required
instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for about 15 minutes.
Cook the rice in water until soft and fluffy.
Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds until aromatic.
Mix the cooked rice with the cumin tempering and serve warm.

ingredients:
2 cups whole wheat flour
1 cup fresh fenugreek leaves chopped
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp chili powder
2 tbsp oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Mix wheat flour with chopped fenugreek leaves and spices to form a soft dough.
Add water gradually and knead until smooth.
Roll small portions of the dough into thin flatbreads.
Cook the theplas on a hot tawa with a little oil until golden on both sides.

ingredients:
1 cup gram flour (besan)
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tbsp oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Mix gram flour, yogurt, turmeric, salt, and water to form a smooth batter.
Allow the batter to rest for about 10 minutes and add a little fruit salt or baking soda.
Pour the batter into a greased steaming tray and steam for about 10–12 minutes.
Prepare a tempering with mustard seeds and oil, pour it over the steamed dhokla, and cut into pieces.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables (potato, peas, carrot)
2 tbsp butter
1 onion finely chopped
2 tomatoes chopped
1 tbsp pav bhaji masala
4 pav bread buns
instructions:
Boil and mash the mixed vegetables until soft.
Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions and tomatoes with pav bhaji masala.
Add the mashed vegetables and cook while mashing until a thick bhaji forms.
Toast the pav buns with butter on a hot pan and serve them with the hot bhaji.

ingredients:
1 cup mixed sprouts
1 onion finely chopped
2 tomatoes chopped
1 tbsp misal masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
4 pav bread buns
instructions:
Cook the sprouts in water with salt until soft.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions, tomatoes, and spices until aromatic.
Add the cooked sprouts and simmer the curry to create the spicy misal gravy.
Serve the hot misal topped with onions and farsan along with toasted pav.

ingredients:
3 boiled potatoes mashed
1 cup gram flour
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp chili powder
4 pav buns
Oil for frying
instructions:
Prepare the potato filling by sautéing mustard seeds, spices, and mashed potatoes.
Shape the potato mixture into small balls.
Dip each ball into gram flour batter and deep fry until golden brown.
Place the fried vada inside pav bread with chutneys and serve.

ingredients:
1 cup green gram soaked
1/4 cup rice
1 inch ginger
1 green chili
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Soak green gram and rice for several hours.
Grind them with ginger and chili to form a thick batter.
Spread the batter on a hot dosa pan into a thin circle.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, drumstick)
1/2 cup grated coconut
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp coconut oil
instructions:
Boil the mixed vegetables with salt and a little water until tender.
Grind coconut and cumin seeds into a coarse paste.
Add the coconut paste and yogurt to the vegetables and mix gently.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups rice soaked
1/2 cup grated coconut
1 tsp yeast
1 tsp sugar
Salt to taste
instructions:
Grind soaked rice with coconut to make a smooth batter.
Add yeast, sugar, and salt and allow the batter to ferment overnight.
Heat an appam pan and pour a ladle of batter into the center.
Swirl the pan to spread the batter and cook until soft with crispy edges.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1 cup coconut milk
2 potatoes chopped
1 onion sliced
1 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp coconut oil
instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a pot and sauté onions and spices.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Add potatoes and coconut milk and allow the stew to simmer.
Cook until the chicken becomes tender and the gravy thickens.

ingredients:
1 cup rice flour
1/2 cup grated coconut
1/2 cup jaggery
1 tsp cardamom powder
Water as required
instructions:
Prepare the filling by cooking coconut and jaggery together until thick.
Boil water with a little salt and mix in rice flour to form a soft dough.
Shape small dumplings and fill them with the sweet coconut mixture.
Steam the dumplings for about 10 minutes until cooked.

ingredients:
1 liter milk
2 tbsp lemon juice
1 cup sugar
3 cups water
1 tsp cardamom
instructions:
Boil the milk and add lemon juice to curdle it and form chenna.
Strain the chenna and knead it until smooth.
Shape the chenna into small balls.
Cook the balls in boiling sugar syrup until they expand and become soft.

ingredients:
1 liter full fat milk
2 tbsp lemon juice
1/4 cup powdered sugar
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
1 tbsp chopped pistachios
instructions:
Boil the milk in a pan and add lemon juice to curdle it and form fresh chenna.
Strain the chenna through a cloth and squeeze out excess water.
Knead the chenna with sugar and cardamom powder until smooth.
Shape the mixture into small sweets and garnish with pistachios.

ingredients:
2 cups wheat flour
1 cup roasted sattu flour
1 onion finely chopped
1 tomato chopped
2 tbsp mustard oil
1 tsp cumin seeds
instructions:
Prepare dough using wheat flour, salt, and water and keep it aside.
Mix sattu flour with chopped onion, spices, mustard oil, and a little water for stuffing.
Stuff the mixture inside dough balls and bake them in an oven or over charcoal until crisp.
Serve the baked litti with mashed vegetable chokha made from roasted eggplant, tomato, and potato.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables
1/2 cup cashew paste
1/2 cup cream
1 onion chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and spices until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and cook them lightly for a few minutes.
Stir in cashew paste and cream to create a rich gravy.
Simmer the curry until vegetables are tender and the sauce thickens.

ingredients:
500 g boneless chicken pieces
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions:
Marinate chicken pieces with yogurt, spices, ginger garlic paste, and lemon juice.
Allow the chicken to marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers and grill them in an oven or tandoor.
Cook until the chicken becomes tender and slightly charred before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup spinach leaves
1/2 cup green peas
2 boiled potatoes
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp breadcrumbs
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Blanch spinach and grind it lightly with peas.
Mix the paste with mashed potatoes, spices, and breadcrumbs.
Shape the mixture into small flat patties.
Shallow fry the patties in oil until crisp and golden on both sides.

ingredients:
500 g mutton pieces
1 cup yogurt
2 onions chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pan and sauté onions and spices.
Add mutton pieces and cook until they begin to brown.
Stir in yogurt and cook slowly so the gravy thickens and flavors develop.
Simmer the curry until the mutton becomes tender and aromatic.

ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
400 g mutton pieces
1/2 cup yogurt
1 onion sliced
1 tsp whole spices
2 tbsp ghee
instructions:
Cook mutton with whole spices to prepare a flavorful stock.
Wash and soak basmati rice for about 15 minutes.
Heat ghee in a pot and sauté onions before adding the rice.
Pour in the prepared stock and cook until the rice becomes fluffy.

ingredients:
2 boiled potatoes
1/2 cup grated carrot
1/2 cup green peas
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Mash potatoes and mix with carrot, peas, spices, and salt.
Shape the mixture into small oval patties.
Coat the patties with breadcrumbs for a crispy texture.
Shallow fry them in oil until golden brown.

ingredients:
1 cup sabudana soaked
1 boiled potato chopped
1/4 cup roasted peanuts
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Soak sabudana in water for several hours until soft.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté cumin seeds and peanuts.
Add chopped potatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Mix in the soaked sabudana and cook gently until fluffy.

ingredients:
600 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions:
Make deep cuts on the chicken pieces and marinate with yogurt, spices, and lemon juice.
Allow the chicken to marinate for at least one hour for best flavor.
Place the chicken on a grill rack or baking tray.
Roast in a hot oven or tandoor until the chicken becomes juicy and slightly charred.

ingredients:
1 cup rice
1/2 cup moong dal
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, peas)
1 tbsp ghee
1 tsp cumin seeds
Salt to taste
instructions:
Wash rice and moong dal thoroughly and soak them for about 10 minutes.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker and sauté cumin seeds and vegetables.
Add rice and dal along with water and salt and mix well.
Pressure cook until soft and slightly mushy before serving hot.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup cashew paste
1/2 cup cream
1 onion finely chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions until golden brown.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Mix in cashew paste, cream, and spices to create a rich gravy.
Simmer the curry until the chicken becomes tender and flavorful.

ingredients:
200 g paneer cubes
1 cup green peas
2 tomatoes pureed
1 onion chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and spices until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until the mixture thickens.
Stir in green peas and cook for a few minutes.
Add paneer cubes and simmer gently before serving.

ingredients:
4 capsicum peppers
2 boiled potatoes mashed
1 onion chopped
1 tsp chili powder
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Cut the tops off the capsicums and remove the seeds.
Prepare the stuffing by mixing mashed potatoes, onions, and spices.
Fill each capsicum with the prepared stuffing mixture.
Cook the stuffed capsicums in a pan with oil until tender.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1 onion sliced
2 tomatoes chopped
1 bell pepper sliced
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp kadai masala
instructions:
Heat oil in a kadai and sauté onions until translucent.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Mix in tomatoes, bell peppers, and kadai masala.
Cook until the chicken is fully cooked and coated in thick gravy.

ingredients:
1 large brinjal (eggplant)
1 onion chopped
2 tomatoes chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp cumin seeds
Salt to taste
instructions:
Roast the brinjal over an open flame until the skin is charred.
Peel the skin and mash the soft pulp.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté cumin seeds, onions, and tomatoes.
Add the mashed brinjal and cook with spices for several minutes.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables
1 onion sliced
2 tomatoes chopped
1 bell pepper sliced
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp garam masala
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until slightly golden.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until a thick sauce forms.
Stir in mixed vegetables and bell peppers.
Cook while stirring until the vegetables are tender but still slightly crisp.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup grated coconut
2 onions chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tbsp chettinad spice mix
1 tsp curry leaves
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and curry leaves.
Add chicken pieces and cook until they start to brown.
Mix in roasted spices and coconut paste.
Simmer the curry until the chicken becomes tender and flavorful.

ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables
1 cup coconut milk
1 onion sliced
1 potato chopped
2 tbsp coconut oil
1 tsp black pepper
instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a pan and sauté onions and spices.
Add vegetables and potatoes and cook lightly.
Pour in coconut milk and allow the stew to simmer.
Cook until vegetables are soft and the gravy thickens slightly.

ingredients:
2 cups grated beetroot
1/2 cup grated coconut
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 green chili chopped
Salt to taste
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they splutter.
Add chopped green chili and grated beetroot.
Cook while stirring until the beetroot becomes soft.
Mix in grated coconut and cook briefly before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup yogurt
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tbsp chopped coriander
1 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Mash the cooked rice slightly while it is still warm.
Add yogurt and salt to the rice and mix well until creamy.
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they splutter.
Pour the tempering over the curd rice, garnish with coriander, and serve chilled.

ingredients:
2 parottas chopped
2 eggs
1/2 cup cooked chicken pieces
1 onion chopped
1 tomato chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and tomatoes with spices.
Add cooked chicken pieces and mix well.
Break the eggs into the pan and scramble them with the mixture.
Add chopped parotta and stir fry everything together until well combined.

ingredients:
200 g mushrooms sliced
1 onion chopped
2 tomatoes pureed
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until soft.
Add tomato puree and spices and cook until the mixture thickens.
Stir in the sliced mushrooms and mix well.
Cook until the mushrooms become tender and coated with the gravy.

ingredients:
300 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup gram flour
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
Oil for frying
Salt to taste
instructions:
Mix gram flour, spices, and water to form a thick batter.
Add chicken pieces to the batter and coat them evenly.
Heat oil in a deep pan and drop the coated chicken pieces into the oil.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy before serving.

ingredients:
200 g noodles
1 cup shredded cabbage
1 carrot julienned
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp garlic chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Boil the noodles in salted water until just cooked and drain them.
Heat oil in a wok and sauté garlic until aromatic.
Add cabbage and carrot and stir fry on high heat.
Add noodles and soy sauce and toss everything together.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup diced chicken
1/2 cup mixed vegetables
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp garlic chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a wok and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add diced chicken and cook until tender.
Stir in vegetables and cook briefly on high heat.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce and toss until evenly mixed.

ingredients:
2 cups basmati rice
1 cup mixed vegetables
1/2 cup yogurt
1 onion sliced
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp biryani masala
instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until golden brown.
Add vegetables, yogurt, and spices and cook until fragrant.
Layer the partially cooked rice over the vegetables and cook on low heat until done.

ingredients:
400 g fish fillets
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Marinate the fish with chili powder, turmeric, lemon juice, and salt.
Allow the fish to rest for about 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and place the marinated fish pieces.
Shallow fry until both sides are crisp and golden.

ingredients:
1 cup green gram soaked
1/2 cup semolina
1 onion chopped
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Prepare upma by roasting semolina and cooking it with water and spices.
Grind soaked green gram into a thick batter.
Spread the batter on a dosa pan to make pesarattu.
Place a portion of upma inside the dosa and fold before serving.

ingredients:
6 small brinjals
1/4 cup roasted peanuts
1 onion chopped
2 tomatoes chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp chili powder
instructions:
Make a spice paste using roasted peanuts and spices.
Cut the brinjals partially and stuff them with the prepared mixture.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and tomatoes.
Add the stuffed brinjals and cook until tender in the gravy.

ingredients:
1 cup green gram soaked
1 small piece ginger
1 green chili
2 boiled potatoes mashed
1 onion finely chopped
1 tsp cumin seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Soak green gram for several hours and grind it with ginger and chili to make a smooth batter.
Heat oil in a pan and prepare potato masala by sautéing onions, cumin seeds, and mashed potatoes.
Pour a ladle of pesarattu batter onto a hot dosa pan and spread it thinly.
Place the potato masala in the center of the dosa, fold it, and cook until crisp before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup cashew nuts
1/2 cup sugar
1/4 cup water
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
1 tsp ghee
instructions:
Grind the cashew nuts into a fine powder without releasing oil.
Prepare a sugar syrup by heating sugar and water until slightly sticky.
Add the cashew powder and cardamom to the syrup and cook until a soft dough forms.
Spread the mixture on a greased plate, flatten it, and cut into diamond shapes.

ingredients:
2 cups grated carrots
2 cups milk
1/2 cup sugar
2 tbsp ghee
1/4 cup chopped nuts
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
instructions:
Heat ghee in a heavy pan and sauté grated carrots for a few minutes.
Add milk and cook on medium heat until the milk reduces.
Stir in sugar and continue cooking until the mixture thickens.
Add nuts and cardamom powder and cook briefly before serving warm.

ingredients:
2 cups flattened rice (poha)
1 onion chopped
1/4 cup roasted peanuts
1 green chili chopped
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Rinse poha gently in water and allow it to soften.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté mustard seeds, onions, peanuts, and green chili.
Add the softened poha along with salt and mix well.
Cook briefly while stirring and garnish with coriander before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups puffed rice
1 onion finely chopped
1 tomato chopped
2 tbsp tamarind chutney
2 tbsp green chutney
1/2 cup sev
1 tsp chaat masala
instructions:
Combine puffed rice, chopped onion, and tomato in a large bowl.
Add tamarind chutney and green chutney and mix gently.
Sprinkle chaat masala and sev for extra flavor and crunch.
Mix everything lightly and serve immediately while crisp.

ingredients:
1 cup dosa batter
1 onion finely chopped
1 green chili chopped
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tbsp chopped coriander
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a paniyaram pan and add mustard seeds until they splutter.
Mix onions, chilies, and coriander into the dosa batter.
Pour small portions of batter into each cavity of the pan.
Cook until golden on both sides and remove when crisp.

ingredients:
1 cup semolina (rava)
1 cup sugar
3 tbsp ghee
1/4 cup cashews
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
2 cups water
instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan and fry cashews until golden.
Add semolina and roast until aromatic.
Pour in water and cook until the semolina absorbs the liquid.
Add sugar and cardamom powder and cook until thick and glossy.

ingredients:
1 cup wheat milk extract
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup ghee
1/4 cup cashews
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
instructions:
Heat wheat milk extract in a heavy pan and cook slowly.
Add sugar and stir continuously until the mixture thickens.
Gradually add ghee while stirring so the halwa becomes glossy.
Garnish with fried cashews and cook until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan.

ingredients:
2 cups full cream milk
1/4 cup sugar
1/4 cup chopped pistachios
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
1 tbsp condensed milk
instructions:
Boil milk in a pan and reduce it slowly until thick and creamy.
Add sugar, condensed milk, and cardamom powder and mix well.
Stir in chopped pistachios and cook for a few minutes.
Pour the mixture into molds and freeze until firm.

ingredients:
1 cup all purpose flour
2 tbsp yogurt
1 cup sugar
1/2 tsp baking soda
Oil for frying
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
instructions:
Prepare a batter using flour, yogurt, and water and allow it to ferment.
Make a sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water with cardamom.
Pour the batter into a piping bottle and pipe spiral shapes into hot oil.
Fry until crisp and dip immediately into the warm sugar syrup.

ingredients:
1 cup urad dal soaked
1 cup sugar
1/2 tsp cardamom powder
Oil for deep frying
2 cups water
instructions:
Soak urad dal for several hours and grind it into a smooth thick batter.
Prepare a sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water with cardamom powder.
Pour the batter into a piping bag and pipe spiral shapes into hot oil.
Deep fry until crisp and dip immediately into the warm sugar syrup.

ingredients:
1 cup gram flour (besan)
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup ghee
1/2 cup water
1/4 tsp cardamom powder
instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan and roast gram flour until aromatic.
Prepare a sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water until slightly thick.
Add roasted gram flour slowly into the syrup while stirring continuously.
Pour the mixture into a greased tray and allow it to set before cutting into pieces.

ingredients:
250 g paneer cubes
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions:
Mix yogurt with spices, ginger garlic paste, and lemon juice to prepare the marinade.
Add paneer cubes and coat them well with the marinade.
Thread the paneer pieces onto skewers and place them on a grill tray.
Grill in an oven or pan until lightly charred and serve hot.

ingredients:
400 g boneless chicken
2 cloves garlic minced
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tsp paprika
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 flatbread wraps
instructions:
Marinate chicken with yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or pan cook the marinated chicken until fully cooked.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
Wrap the chicken in flatbread with vegetables and sauce before serving.

ingredients:
400 g minced mutton
1 onion finely chopped
2 tomatoes chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until soft.
Stir in the minced mutton and mix thoroughly.
Cook on medium heat until the meat is tender and the masala thickens.

ingredients:
4 eggs
1 onion chopped
1 tomato chopped
1 green chili chopped
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and green chili.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until soft.
Crack the eggs into the pan and scramble them with the masala.
Cook until the eggs are fluffy and fully cooked.

ingredients:
400 g chicken wings
1/2 cup all purpose flour
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp garlic paste
2 tbsp soy sauce
Oil for frying
instructions:
Marinate chicken wings with garlic paste, soy sauce, and spices.
Coat the chicken pieces in flour batter evenly.
Deep fry the coated chicken pieces in hot oil until crispy.
Toss the fried chicken in spicy sauce before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
200 g paneer cubes
1/2 cup mixed vegetables
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp garlic chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a wok and sauté chopped garlic.
Add paneer cubes and cook until lightly golden.
Stir in vegetables and cook on high heat for a few minutes.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce and toss everything together.

ingredients:
1 cup cauliflower florets
1/2 cup gram flour
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
Oil for frying
Salt to taste
instructions:
Blanch cauliflower florets briefly in hot water.
Prepare a batter using gram flour, spices, and water.
Dip the cauliflower pieces in batter and coat well.
Deep fry until crispy and toss with curry leaves and spices.

ingredients:
2 rotis
1 cup mixed vegetables
1 onion sliced
1 tbsp tomato sauce
1 tsp chili powder
1 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté vegetables with spices.
Cook the mixture until the vegetables become tender.
Place the cooked vegetables on a roti and add sauce and onions.
Roll the roti tightly to form a frankie and serve hot.

ingredients:
2 rotis
200 g cooked chicken strips
1 onion sliced
1 tbsp tomato sauce
1 tsp chili powder
1 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté the cooked chicken with chili powder and salt.
Add sliced onions and cook briefly until slightly soft.
Place the cooked chicken mixture onto a roti and drizzle tomato sauce over it.
Roll the roti tightly to form a frankie and serve hot.

ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup fresh coriander leaves
2 green chilies
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Grind coriander leaves and green chilies into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds until they splutter.
Add the coriander paste and cook for a few minutes until aromatic.
Mix the cooked rice with the coriander mixture and serve warm.

ingredients:
1 cup urad dal soaked
2 cups yogurt
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 green chili chopped
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Grind soaked urad dal into a thick batter and shape small vadas.
Deep fry the vadas in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk yogurt with salt until smooth and creamy.
Soak the fried vadas in yogurt and garnish with tempering before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup dosa batter
1 onion finely chopped
1 green chili chopped
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tbsp coriander leaves
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a paniyaram pan and add mustard seeds until they crackle.
Mix chopped onions, chilies, and coriander into the batter.
Pour small amounts of batter into the paniyaram cavities.
Cook until golden on both sides and serve hot.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1 onion finely chopped
2 tomatoes pureed
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
Salt to taste
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions until golden.
Add tomato puree and spices and cook until thick.
Add chicken pieces and mix well with the gravy.
Cook until the chicken becomes tender and the gravy thickens.

ingredients:
250 g paneer cubes
1 onion chopped
2 tomatoes pureed
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp butter
instructions:
Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions until soft.
Add tomato puree and spices and cook until the sauce thickens.
Add paneer cubes and simmer gently in the gravy.
Stir in cream and cook briefly before serving.

ingredients:
500 g chicken pieces
1/2 cup yogurt
1/4 cup cashew paste
1 onion paste
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onion paste until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Mix yogurt and cashew paste into the pan to create a creamy gravy.
Simmer until the chicken becomes tender and the sauce thickens.

ingredients:
2 rotis
1 cup mixed vegetables
1 onion sliced
1 tbsp chili sauce
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp cooking oil
instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté mixed vegetables with spices.
Cook until vegetables become tender but slightly crisp.
Place the vegetable mixture onto a roti and add sliced onions and sauce.
Roll the roti tightly and serve the frankie hot.

ingredients:
500 g mutton pieces
1/2 cup grated coconut
2 onions chopped
1 tbsp chili powder
2 tbsp cooking oil
1 tsp curry leaves
instructions:
Cook mutton pieces with salt until tender.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and curry leaves.
Add cooked mutton with spices and roast until dry.
Mix in grated coconut and cook briefly before serving.

ingredients:
2 cups milk
2 tbsp custard powder
1/4 cup sugar
1 cup mixed fruits (apple, banana, grapes)
1/2 tsp vanilla essence
instructions:
Heat milk in a pan and dissolve custard powder in a small portion of milk.
Add the custard mixture to the boiling milk and stir continuously.
Add sugar and cook until the custard thickens.
Cool the custard slightly and mix in chopped fruits before serving.
